question: What is Central Finland wellbeing services county doing about lung cancer care right now?

findings.what_en: In April 2026 a Finance Ministry evaluation group proposed moving Sairaala Nova's demanding specialist care to KYS in Kuopio; no final decision had been made.
findings.what_fi: Valtiovarainministeriön arviointiryhmä esitti huhtikuussa 2026 Sairaala Novan vaativan erikoissairaanhoidon siirtämistä KYSiin; lopullista päätöstä ei ollut tehty.

findings.what_en: Hyvaks discusses every new lung cancer patient in a multidisciplinary meeting with a pulmonologist, surgeon, oncologist and radiologist.

findings.what_en: Sairaala Nova's oncology unit provides all adult radiotherapy and cancer drug therapy for the county and some radiotherapy for South Savo.
findings.what_fi: Sairaala Novan syöpätautien ja sädehoidon vastuualue hoitaa kaikki alueen aikuisten säde- ja syöpälääkehoidot.
findings.quote: Sairaala Novan syöpätautien ja sädehoidon vastuualue vastaa kaikista Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen aikuispotilaiden säde- ja syöpälääkehoidoista sekä osasta Etelä-Savon potilaiden sädehoidosta.
findings.title: Syöpätaudit ja sädehoito

summary_en: I found six facts. Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialue (Hyvaks) publishes a lung cancer care pathway. Under it, every new patient is discussed at a multidisciplinary meeting, pathology results take about 1–2 weeks, and patients who can be operated on get a surgical clinic appointment about 1–2 weeks after referral. Sairaala Nova gives all radiotherapy and cancer drug therapy for the county's adults. The biggest open question is the Finance Ministry evaluation group's April 2026 proposal to move Nova's demanding specialist care to KYS in Kuopio. No final decision had been made at the time of that article, and I did not check later news. Before funding anything at Nova, check where that stands.
not_found_en: I did not search specifically for screening pilots, nurse navigators, reflex molecular testing, video multidisciplinary meetings with KYS or published waiting-time figures, so their absence here is not evidence that they don't exist. Broad searches on the county site and for county board decisions brought up no lung cancer decision, project or investment.
